basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

special.name: 特殊技：天罗
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：地网
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射飞刃和强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodge.name: 闪避：瞬闪
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行多段穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：藏锋
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：会·离
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，并发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
箭矢命中地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：残心
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：穿弦
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：构身
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：构身·斩
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]的暴击率提升25%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]/[终结技]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1/6层[锋芒]，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]在同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]造成的暴击伤害提升12%。
fields.textEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate increase by 25%. When Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash/Ultimate triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1/6 stacks of Gleaming Edge. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash can grant a maximum of 3 stacks per activation, and Gleaming Edge can stack up to 6 times, lasting 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate by 12%.

fields.text:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[异常]角色时触发：
悠真攻击命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升40%；悠真发射[落羽]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，会为其施加2层[电囚]效果。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Anomaly character:
When Harumasa's attacks hit Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, his DMG increases by 40%. When Harumasa's Falling Feather hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, it will apply 2 stacks of Electro Prison to the target.

basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云·移形
basic.description:
[普通攻击：穿云]发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
发动远程穿透攻击，并向拖曳方向调整身位，对前方敌人造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：落羽
basic.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
立即向前方敌人发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
长按 【普通攻击键】 瞄准目标，松开 【普通攻击键】 发动：
引弓瞄准敌人后，向目标发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold [Basic Attack] to aim at a target and release [Basic Attack] to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：甲乙矢
basic.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]/[强化特殊技]/[连携技]命中敌人或地面时，可生成2/6/6枚[电壶]；
若场上不存在[电壶]，队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，可生成6枚[电壶]，12秒内最多触发一次；
[电壶]同一时间内最多存在6枚，悠真发射[落羽]命中敌人时，若场上存在[电壶]，则会将其激活，向被[落羽]命中的目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
[甲乙矢]命中敌人时，会为其施加[电囚]效果，最多叠加8层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[电囚]效果大于等于2层时，将在目标身上生成[十文字]标记。
basic.descriptionEn:
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Electric DMG.
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行多段穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
basic.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
basic.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时会触发[逐雷]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
第一段招式期间可以格挡敌人攻击，第二、第三段招式的追击效果增强；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:

ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
ex.description:

强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:

Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：地网·巡弋（潜能觉醒）
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol (Potential Awakening)
ex.description:
能量足够时，在第四/五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[终结技]、[闪避反击：藏锋]、[快速支援：穿弦]发动后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
第一发强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]，最后一发强化箭矢命中敌人时，激活场上的[电壶]，向目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
命中的目标持有的[电囚]效果层数接近上限时，会激活更少的[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 Electro Quivers are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the Electro Quivers on the field, firing Ha-Oto no Ya at the target, dealing Electric DMG.
When the target's Electro Prison stacks are close to the maximum, fewer Electro Quivers will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：残心
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 残心·散华（潜能觉醒）
ultimate.description:
[终结技：残心]发动后自动派生：
对前方敌人发动大范围穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：穿弦
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 普通攻击：穿云
fields.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

fields.name: 普通攻击：穿云·移形
fields.trigger: [普通攻击：穿云]发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
[普通攻击：穿云]发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
发动远程穿透攻击，并向拖曳方向调整身位，对前方敌人造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 普通攻击：落羽
fields.trigger: 第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
立即向前方敌人发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
长按 【普通攻击键】 瞄准目标，松开 【普通攻击键】 发动：
引弓瞄准敌人后，向目标发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold [Basic Attack] to aim at a target and release [Basic Attack] to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

fields.name: 普通攻击：甲乙矢
fields.trigger: 第五段[普通攻击：穿云]/[强化特殊技]/[连携技]命中敌人或地面时，可生成2/6/6枚[电壶]；
fields.triggerEn: When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
fields.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]/[强化特殊技]/[连携技]命中敌人或地面时，可生成2/6/6枚[电壶]；
若场上不存在[电壶]，队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，可生成6枚[电壶]，12秒内最多触发一次；
[电壶]同一时间内最多存在6枚，悠真发射[落羽]命中敌人时，若场上存在[电壶]，则会将其激活，向被[落羽]命中的目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
[甲乙矢]命中敌人时，会为其施加[电囚]效果，最多叠加8层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[电囚]效果大于等于2层时，将在目标身上生成[十文字]标记。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Electric DMG.
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

fields.name: 特殊技：天罗
fields.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：地网
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射飞刃和强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：地网·巡弋（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol (Potential Awakening)
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，在第四/五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[终结技]、[闪避反击：藏锋]、[快速支援：穿弦]发动后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，在第四/五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[终结技]、[闪避反击：藏锋]、[快速支援：穿弦]发动后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
第一发强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]，最后一发强化箭矢命中敌人时，激活场上的[电壶]，向目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
命中的目标持有的[电囚]效果层数接近上限时，会激活更少的[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 Electro Quivers are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the Electro Quivers on the field, firing Ha-Oto no Ya at the target, dealing Electric DMG.
When the target's Electro Prison stacks are close to the maximum, fewer Electro Quivers will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 闪避：瞬闪
fields.trigger: 点按 【闪避键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Dodge] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦
fields.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行多段穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 闪避反击：藏锋
fields.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 连携技：会·离
fields.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
fields.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
fields.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，并发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
箭矢命中地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 终结技：残心
fields.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
fields.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 残心·散华（潜能觉醒）
fields.trigger: [终结技：残心]发动后自动派生：
fields.triggerEn: Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
fields.description:
[终结技：残心]发动后自动派生：
对前方敌人发动大范围穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 快速支援：穿弦
fields.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 招架支援：构身
fields.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 支援突击：构身·斩
fields.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
fields.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
fields.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
fields.trigger: [醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时会触发[逐雷]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
第一段招式期间可以格挡敌人攻击，第二、第三段招式的追击效果增强；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
fields.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

fields.name: 核心被动：破晓
fields.trigger: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]的暴击率提升25%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]/[终结技]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1/6层[锋芒]，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]在同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]造成的暴击伤害提升12%。
fields.triggerEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate increase by 25%. When Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash/Ultimate triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1/6 stacks of Gleaming Edge. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash can grant a maximum of 3 stacks per activation, and Gleaming Edge can stack up to 6 times, lasting 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate by 12%.
fields.description: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]的暴击率提升25%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]/[终结技]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1/6层[锋芒]，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]在同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]造成的暴击伤害提升12%。
fields.descriptionEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate increase by 25%. When Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash/Ultimate triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1/6 stacks of Gleaming Edge. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash can grant a maximum of 3 stacks per activation, and Gleaming Edge can stack up to 6 times, lasting 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate by 12%.

fields.name: 额外能力：超频
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在[击破]角色或[异常]角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is a Stun or Anomaly character:
fields.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[异常]角色时触发：
悠真攻击命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升40%；悠真发射[落羽]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，会为其施加2层[电囚]效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Anomaly character:
When Harumasa's attacks hit Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, his DMG increases by 40%. When Harumasa's Falling Feather hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, it will apply 2 stacks of Electro Prison to the target.

fields.name: 潜能觉醒：贯注
fields.trigger: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.triggerEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.
fields.description: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.descriptionEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：地网·巡弋（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol (Potential Awakening)
fields.description:
能量足够时，在第四/五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[终结技]、[闪避反击：藏锋]、[快速支援：穿弦]发动后点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
第一发强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]，最后一发强化箭矢命中敌人时，激活场上的[电壶]，向目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
命中的目标持有的[电囚]效果层数接近上限时，会激活更少的[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 Electro Quivers are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the Electro Quivers on the field, firing Ha-Oto no Ya at the target, dealing Electric DMG.
When the target's Electro Prison stacks are close to the maximum, fewer Electro Quivers will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 残心·散华（潜能觉醒）
fields.description:
[终结技：残心]发动后自动派生：
对前方敌人发动大范围穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害，视为[终结技]伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 核心被动：破晓
fields.description: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]的暴击率提升25%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]/[终结技]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1/6层[锋芒]，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]在同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]、[逐雷]和[终结技]造成的暴击伤害提升12%。
fields.descriptionEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate increase by 25%. When Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash/Ultimate triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1/6 stacks of Gleaming Edge. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash can grant a maximum of 3 stacks per activation, and Gleaming Edge can stack up to 6 times, lasting 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, Chasing Thunder, and Ultimate by 12%.

fields.name: 额外能力：超频
fields.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色或[异常]角色时触发：
悠真攻击命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升40%；悠真发射[落羽]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人时，会为其施加2层[电囚]效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Anomaly character:
When Harumasa's attacks hit Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, his DMG increases by 40%. When Harumasa's Falling Feather hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomaly, it will apply 2 stacks of Electro Prison to the target.

fields.name: 潜能觉醒：贯注
fields.description: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.descriptionEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.

fields.triggerEn: When activating an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, increases ATK by 4%. Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash and Chasing Thunder ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
